title: A past session is listed and looked through, and a route is put together in the window

steps.check: the session has begun: a new character's run is on the HUD
the History tab marks the session being played
and lists the one ended before it under whose it was
the footer counts the past sessions and says what a click does

drawn.text: 1 past session. Click one to look through it

steps.check: a click marks the past session as the one being looked through
and not the one being played
the Overview is the past session's, with the day it began
and the footer says whose session is up
clicking the session being played goes back to it
the Routes tab opens on the route runs are timed on
and says which that is

drawn.text: 5 splits, the route runs are timed on

steps.check: the route's splits are listed in order, with what marks each
what can be done is in blue
and the splits there are to add are under their difficulty
a new route is the one being changed
and has no splits
the search box narrows the splits there are to add
to the ones that have the text
and offers the text as the route's name
the routes above are all still listed
a split clicked is added to the route and picked out
the footer says where the next one will go

drawn.text: A split clicked below is added after the one picked out

steps.check: a right click on a split of the route removes it
deleting the route is asked for twice, the second time in red

drawn.text: Click again to delete My route 1

steps.check: and then it is gone
with the route runs are timed on the one being changed again
